summary: 305 of 641 FMD outbreaks reported nationally (Jan-Mar 2026) occurred in Jawa Tengah; non-zoonotic TAD, not a human health event.

title: Official FMD risk zoning declared (red/yellow/green)
response: WOAH recognition application for FMD-free zones without vaccination submitted Aug 2025
source_name: ANTARA News (Dirjen PKH Agung Suganda, Kementerian Pertanian RI)
verification: Direct quote from Direktur Jenderal Peternakan dan Kesehatan Hewan
summary: Red zone (endemic): Java, Bali, Lampung, NTB. Yellow zone: Sumatra, Sulawesi, Kalimantan. Nine provinces (incl. Papua, Maluku, Maluku Utara, NTT) declared free of FMD without vaccination.

title: ASF lab-confirmed, Karangasem, Bali
location: Desa Ban, Kec. Kubu, Karangasem, Bali, Indonesia
response: Containment measures to prevent spread to other regencies
source_name: Balipost (I Wayan Sunada, Kepala Dinas Pertanian & Ketahanan Pangan Provinsi Bali)
verification: Official confirms ASF first found in Bali in 2020; this is a re-confirmation, not first case
summary: Positive lab sample confirmed ASF in Karangasem; provincial official states ASF first detected in Bali in 2020, NOT a first case in 2024/2026.

title: ASF declared endemic in Bali by provincial authority
response: Biosecurity advisory to farmers; no vaccine yet available locally per this source
source_name: Tribun Bali (Dinas Pertanian & Ketahanan Pangan Provinsi Bali)
verification: Follows new pig deaths in Canggu & Payangan, Apr 2026; official statement labels ASF as already endemic, not a new first case
summary: Distan Bali confirms ASF is now an endemic disease in Bali following new localized die-offs; supersedes earlier FAO phrasing that could be misread as a first case.

title: ASF outbreak, Polewali Mandar, Sulawesi Barat
response: Samples sent to Balai Veteriner Maros; movement restriction of affected livestock
source_name: FAO Situation Update - ASF in Asia-Pacific
verification: Initially reported as suspected/unconfirmed by local media (Detik Sulsel, 1 Jul 2026) pending Balai Veteriner Maros lab results; later stated as confirmed in FAO's situation update
summary: 83 pigs died after an infected pig from Mamasa was introduced 3 Jun 2026 for a community celebration; outbreak flagged 23 Jun, later confirmed.

title: ASF officially reported in 32 of 34 provinces
response: iSIKHNAS surveillance; 8 Disease Investigation Centers; DIC Medan reference lab
source_name: FAO Situation Update - ASF in Asia-Pacific
verification: FAO text states '32 of 34 provinces' - denominator of 34 does not match Indonesia's current 38 provinces (post-2022 Papua splits); likely an outdated FAO count, flagged for cross-check
summary: Genotype II, stable since first outbreak Dec 2019 (North Sumatra); nationally reported in 32 of 34 provinces per FAO (see verification note on denominator discrepancy).

title: LSD reportedly reaches Bali (media report, unconfirmed by Kementan)
response: Monitored by Australian biosecurity authorities per this source
verification: No official Kementan/Ditjen PKH release found confirming this as of source review (Aug 2026) - flagged rumor pending official confirmation
summary: Foreign media reports LSD reaching Bali, a new geographic front; marked as unverified pending an official Indonesian government confirmation.

title: LSD confirmed across 15 provinces since 2022 emergence
response: ~935,000 vaccine doses distributed since 2022 with Australian government support (DAFF)
source_name: Tropical Animal Health and Production (Springer, peer-reviewed)
verification: First detected Aceh, Mar 2022; vector-borne (Capripoxvirus, biting insects)
summary: LSD confirmed across at least 15 provinces (Aceh, N/W/S Sumatra, Riau, Jambi, Bengkulu, Lampung, Banten, W/C/E Java, DIY, Kalimantan Tengah) since first detection in 2022.
